pages.text: Socket sorcery is worked in four steps:$(br2)1. $(l:socket-sorcery:getting_started/finding_scrolls)Find a pattern scroll$(/l).$(br)2. $(l:socket-sorcery:gems/engravable_gems)Craft a gem$(/l) that can hold its pattern.$(br)3. $(l:socket-sorcery:engraving/chiselling)Engrave$(/l) the symbol onto the gem.$(br)4. $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/the_bench)Socket$(/l) the gem into an accessory and wear it.

The same engraved gem behaves differently depending on where it sits: passive in a $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/necklace)necklace$(/l), cast on command from a $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/bangle)bangle$(/l), and automatic retaliation from a $(l:socket-sorcery:socketing/ring)ring$(/l).$(br2)Socket order matters — gems fire in the order they were set.
